answer.sameness: Five hero recipes rotate across all 50: (1) big serif/sans headline left, photo block right, small underlined 'Pokličite' link; (2) tinted top band with address, headline, photo below; (3) full-bleed photo with dark navy/black caption bar; (4) headline plus grey 'Naslov/Telefon/E-pošta' contact table with hours rules (cvetlicarna, gostilna-pri-mostu, salon-tina, oljka-in-sol, kljucavnicarstvo, instrukcije, instalacije); (5) text-only hero with dropped-cap paragraph. Type is two families only: one high-contrast serif and one grotesk at the same weights and sizes. Palettes repeat: navy, wine red, mustard, forest green, black. Same workshop/interior photo crops, 'Delamo od leta' year block, ri…
recurringIssues: Headlines run off the first screen or wrap mid-word on desktop (instalacije-rebernik-regen, racunovodstvo-seliskar-regen, instrukcije-pia-regen, prevajanje-kolar-gen, karoserija-hribar-gen).
Large dead white areas with content shoved to one edge (elektro-zupan-gen, pizzeria-oljka-gen, instalacije-rebernik-regen, mizarstvo-lesnik-gen).
Tiny underlined text link as the only CTA; no visual call to action in most heroes.
Contact-table hero (name/phone/email rows) makes several services look like a directory listing rather than a designed page.
Drop-cap paragraph with inconsistent wrap looks like a template artefact repeated across businesses.
Photos stacked below the fold on phones leave text-only first screens for many pages.
Same dark caption-bar-under-photo block reused regardless of trade.

best.why: Overlapping headline card on a warm photo, serif type suits the inn, confident composition on both screens.
Full-bleed bread photo with a stacked low-left headline; feels like a bakery, not a template, and holds on phone.
Clean green band, right-sized headline and treatment-room photo give a calm, specific clinical identity.

weakest.why: Giant headline is clipped mid-word on desktop and sits in a wasteland of white with text jammed into the right corner.
Headline breaks 'Računovo-dstvo' and overflows the screen; stray comma at line start, hero cut off.
Nearly empty first screen, no image, headline alone in a grey strip; could be any business.

answer.oneChange: Stop using a fixed set of five hero recipes with two typefaces; give each trade its own hero built around a strong, properly fitted headline (no clipping, no mid-word breaks) and a real button CTA, so the layout, type and image are chosen for the business rather than swapped in.
answer.summary: Competent but formulaic. The 50 homepages are visibly five layouts, two fonts and five colours in rotation; the regen pages are sometimes better (bakery, inn, physio) but also carry the worst defects: headlines that clip off-screen or break inside words, huge empty white areas, and a weak underlined text link as the only call to action. The contact-table hero makes several services read like a listing. Photos are decent but their crops and placements repeat. Fix the type fitting first, then force each page to find its own composition. Right now a business owner would recognise the neighbour's site in their own.
